subject: HelioHealth go-live: customer quote details and media schedule

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Subject: HelioHealth go-live: customer quote details and media schedule

Alex — thanks again for agreeing to collaborate on HelioHealth's announcement. A few things we need to lock down so our comms team can finalize the release: 

1) Official go-live date for public announcement (we were targeting the week of Apr 12)
2) A short quote (1-2 sentences) we can attribute to HelioHealth leadership and approval to use your logo per our brand guidelines
3) Preferred embargo window — if you need a quiet embargo until day/time, please let us know
4) Any legal or regulatory language we should avoid mentioning in the quote

If easier, feel free to attach a draft quote — we can iterate. I’ve attached our press release skeleton and our standard logo usage guide to make approvals quicker.

Next steps from our side: Marissa will take the lead on copy, Lauren will coordinate distribution, and I’ll handle the legal/ops handoff. Can you confirm a point of contact on your side for logo approval and final sign-off?

Appreciate it — excited to get HelioHealth's story out.

— Priyom

Priyom — thanks for the clear list. Answers below: 

1) Go-live window: target public announcement on Apr 14, 2026 (we'll keep an embargo until 9am PT on Apr 14)
2) Draft quote attached (HelioHealth-Quote-Draft.docx). It's from me (VP Marketing); if we can attribute to our CEO instead we'd prefer a slightly shorter line — I'll confirm by Tuesday.
3) Embargo: please respect Apr 14 9am PT. Our legal team requires that all excerpts go through a central review before publication.
4) Avoid mentioning patient-level outcomes or any projection metrics; high-level impact statements are fine.

Point of contact for approvals: Sophie Tan (CC'd) will own logo and quote sign-off. Sophie, can you confirm you'll handle logo delivery in the next 48 hours?

Appreciate the coordination.

— Alex

- Apr 1: Redwood legal review complete (we'll surface any required language before Apr 5)

Also tagging Ben to confirm whether we need a customer case study one-pager to accompany the announcement — marketing ops has capacity to build a short PDF if HelioHealth wants it.

Redlines summary:
- Tightened language to avoid any implied clinical claims
- Shortened the main quote to one sentence for press headlines
